svg.text: Wiring schematic · ESP32 sensor node · GPS · microSD · 2× DS18B20 · Hall RPM
All peripherals are powered from the ESP32 3V3 pin via WAGO-221 splice buses.
Both DS18B20 sensors share one 1-Wire bus on D4.
UART lines are crossed: GPS TX → ESP RX2, GPS RX ← ESP TX2.
· a dot marks a junction — crossings without a dot are not connected
